page: Microsoft Azure EC8eds_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ECEDV5 server family. It runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and features an x86_64 Intel processor with 8 dedicated virtual CPUs. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.
This server configuration includes 232 GB of local storage and supports Premium Storage options. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or graphics processing units.

The high memory-to-vCPU ratio provides qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high compute-core density. The combination of dedicated Intel vCPUs, 64.0 GB of RAM, and local storage makes this instance appropriate for relational databases, in-memory caching layers, and data analytics workloads.
